summary: Let backup export preparation outlive the response-header deadline while remaining cancellable

compatibility.detail: Successful claim-backup archives are unchanged. After headers, preparation failures are a terminal failure record carrying code and message, which is not a valid backup. Updated clients report that cause; old clients reject it as an incomplete/unknown-format export. A concurrent export is refused as backup-busy (503). The CLI has no idle download limit; any separately configured HTTP proxy must allow a long preparation interval before body bytes.

downtime.detail: No new startup migration or downtime requirement.

manual.detail: Use the existing backup create command; no request-timeout tuning or offline database copy is required.

recovery.detail: No stored claims, projections or archive format change.
